diagnosis: The notification preferences route in Fastify uses a globally exposed getPreferences helper to retrieve email digest settings using request.params.userId. It omits checking whether the requesting user is the owner of userId or an administrator, allowing any user to view subscription statuses and digest frequency settings of arbitrary platform users.

Host: prefs.mediahub.com:8095
